hero.title: ‘Concept to completion’ construction & project management

intro.lead: Our reputation as a trusted & committed building contractor is reinforced with every project we deliver.
intro.body: We're builders who provide assurance of a successful outcome for your construction project.
text: As experienced builders, our focus is on providing expert advice, identifying the best options and efficiencies, and working with our clients to deliver their vision with professionalism and dedication to an outstanding end result.
As a Canterbury based business, we are renowned locally as builders who can be trusted. One who works with pride in our delivery, on every project, no matter its size or complexity.

As builders, we take pride in more than just what we build; we ensure that everything we create is completed to the highest quality standards and we work with clients to solve their problems, and allow them to enjoy the process, rather than endure it! We’re builders who build trust, along with exceptional spaces.

designAndBuild.heading: Design & Build
paragraphs: At Tim Day Construction, our Design & Build service provides a complete, end-to-end solution for residential and commercial projects. By bringing both the design and construction elements together under one contract, we offer a streamlined process.
Saving time – Reducing costs – Ensuring your vision is delivered with precision and care.

threeBlocks.title: A team who care about every project

quote.text: I’m not just saying this for effect, but I truly am passionate about the client experience. I want my clients to ENJOY the build not ENDURE the build. I want them to be singing my praises at the end of the job, raising a glass of bubbly with me and the team at the end of the job and recommending me to anyone that will listen.

howWeWork.title: How we work with you to create a process that is enjoyable

blocks.heading: Early engagement
blocks.body: Bringing our experience to the concept stage we can identify and propose cost saving solutions, in collaboration with your designers. We’re builders who add value from day one.

blocks.heading: Watch your vision come to life
blocks.body: Each day, there’s something new to see. Clients are greeted with visible transformations and a team of builders who are passionate about the project as you are.

blocks.heading: Transparent communication
blocks.body: As our builders are constantly making progress on-site, we don’t hide anything. We share everything with you promptly, as and when it happens.
